findings.title: AI crawlers can read your site
findings.message: All 13 checked AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, and more) are allowed in robots.txt.

findings.title: Only 47% of images have alt text
findings.message: 18 out of 34 images on https://www.semrush.com/solutions/competitive-research/ are missing alt text. AI assistants use alt to understand images. Add descriptive alt attributes.

findings.title: No <h1> heading on the page
findings.message: https://www.semrush.com/pricing/ has no <h1>. Every page should have exactly one h1 that describes the page topic.

findings.title: No structured data on this page
findings.message: https://www.semrush.com/solutions/competitive-research/ has no JSON-LD, microdata, or RDFa. Structured data is how AI assistants reliably extract who/what/when about your content. Add at least Organization (site-wide) and Article/Product (per page).

findings.title: No meta description
findings.message: https://www.semrush.com/api-terms/ has no <meta name="description">. Add one — it appears in search snippets and is often quoted by AI assistants.
findings.fixSnippet: <meta name="description" content="A clear, 120-160 character summary of this page." />

findings.title: No llms.txt found
findings.message: llms.txt is an emerging standard for telling LLMs which pages best represent your site. Very few sites have one today — adding one is a fast credibility signal.
findings.fixSnippet:
# https://www.semrush.com
# llms.txt — a curated index of your site for LLMs.
# Place at: https://www.semrush.com/llms.txt

# www.semrush.com

> Short description of what your site offers.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://www.semrush.com/): one-line description
- [About](https://www.semrush.com/about): one-line description
- [Pricing](https://www.semrush.com/pricing): one-line description

findings.title: Redirect chain detected
findings.message: Loading https://www.semrush.com/pricing/ required 2 redirect(s) before reaching https://www.semrush.com/pricing/seo-ai-search/. Each hop slows crawlers; collapse the chain to a single direct redirect.

findings.title: 65% alt-text coverage
findings.message: 18 of 52 images missing alt. Push coverage above 90%.

findings.title: Heading hierarchy skips levels
findings.message: https://www.semrush.com/api-terms/ jumps heading levels (e.g. h2 directly to h4). A clean h1→h2→h3 hierarchy helps AI assistants understand structure.

findings.title: Very low text-to-code ratio
findings.message: https://www.semrush.com/pricing/ has a text-to-code ratio of 2.9%. Most of the page is markup/scripts. Consider whether the visible content can be enriched.

findings.title: Meta description is short
findings.message: https://www.semrush.com/pricing/ meta description is 25 characters. Aim for 120-160.

findings.title: <title> is long
findings.message: https://www.semrush.com/solutions/competitive-research/ title is 72 characters. Google truncates around 60-65. Tighten it.

findings.title: <title> is short
findings.message: https://www.semrush.com/pricing/ title is 15 characters ("Plans & Pricing"). Aim for 30-65 characters with a clear value proposition.

findings.title: 5 sitemap URLs redirect off-site and were not scored
findings.message: These URLs are in www.semrush.com's sitemap but 301-redirect to a different site, so their content lives on another property and was excluded from this report: https://www.semrush.com/api-accounts/ -> https://developer.semrush.com/api/get-started/api-units-balance/; https://www.semrush.com/api-analytics/ -> https://developer.semrush.com/api/seo/overview/; https://www.semrush.com/api-documentation/ -> https://developer.semrush.com/api/; https://www.semrush.com/api-projects/ -> https://developer.semrush.com/api/projects/overview/; https://www.semrush.com/api-use/ -> https://developer.semrush.com/api/. Usually fine (docs or blog consolidated elsewhere); only act if you expected this content to live on www.semrush.com.
